scorch.def: A stacking Solar burn on enemies that deals damage over time; reaching 100 stacks triggers an Ignition.
scorch.q: All Scorch is removed upon reaching x100 Scorch to trigger an Ignition.

ignition.def: A large Solar explosion, usually triggered by maxing out Scorch on an enemy, that clears the Scorch it consumed.
ignition.q: Explosion that deals 676 [120 Guardians | 250 Construct] Solar Damage in a 8 meter radius

radiant.def: A Solar buff that increases your weapon damage (20% in PvE) for a short time.
radiant.q: Increases Weapon Damage by 20% [10%] for 10 seconds and can be extended up to 15 seconds by default.

restoration.def: A Solar buff that continuously heals you over time without being interrupted by damage.
restoration.q: Continuously restores health. Effect is uninterruptible and can be extended up to 15 seconds by default.

cure.def: A Solar buff that instantly heals a chunk of health per stack.
cure.q: Restores 60 [30] HP per stack of Cure over 0.1 seconds.

firesprite.def: A Solar elemental pickup that grants grenade energy when collected.
firesprite.q: Solar Elemental Pickup Grants 11.25% Grenade Ability Energy on Pickup.

sunspot.def: A Solar zone on the ground that scorches enemies inside it and gives you Restoration and Sol Invictus while you stand in it.
sunspot.q: Sunspots grant Sol Invictus for 5 seconds and Restoration x1 for 5+2.5 seconds.

jolt.def: An Arc debuff that makes the enemy release chain lightning to nearby enemies after taking damage.
jolt.q: Jolted Enemies will release chain lightning for 10 [5] seconds

blind.def: An Arc debuff that disorients enemies so they cannot attack or use abilities.
blind.q: Blinded Combatants are disoriented, rendering them unable to attack or use abilities for 10 seconds.

amplified.def: An Arc buff earned through rapid Arc kills or aspects that boosts mobility, handling and slide, and gives some damage resistance.
amplified.q: Intrinsic Arc Subclass Buff Obtained by reaching 100% Counter Progress through Arc Kills within 6 seconds of each, or through Aspects.

ionictrace.def: An Arc elemental pickup that seeks you out and grants grenade, melee and class ability energy.
ionictrace.q: Grants 11.25% Grenade, and Melee Ability Energy, and 13.5% Class Ability Energy on pickup.

boltcharge.def: A stacking Arc buff built by weapon damage; at 10 stacks your next ability hit or melee calls down an Arc bolt on the target.
boltcharge.q: Discharges an Arc Bolt over the damaged enemy

volatile.def: A Void debuff that makes an enemy explode after taking enough damage or when it dies.
volatile.q: Volatile Enemies trigger an explosion after being dealt 190 [200] damage or upon dying

weaken.def: A Void debuff that makes enemies take more damage and move slower.
weaken.q: Weakened Enemies receive 15% [7.5%] increased damage and 20% Decreased Movement Speed for 6 [2.5] seconds.

suppress.def: A Void debuff that cancels active abilities and prevents the enemy from using abilities for a while.
suppress.q: Suppressed Enemies are removed from active abilities and are unable to use abilities for 10 [5] seconds.

devour.def: A Void buff that heals you on activation and on each kill, and grants grenade energy on kills.
devour.q: Scoring a kill while Devour is active restores 70 HP, grants Grenade Ability Energy, and refreshes 5+3 seconds of its duration.

overshield.def: A Void buff that adds a layer of extra health on top of your shields.
overshield.q: Void Overshield with up to 45 HP for 10+5 seconds.

invisibility.def: A Void buff that hides you from enemies until you take an offensive action.
invisibility.q: Cloaks the user, granting various benefits, while lowering Maximum Radar Range to 24 meters for 5+2 seconds. Immediately ends upon performing an Offensive Action.

voidbreach.def: A Void elemental pickup that grants class ability energy when collected.
voidbreach.q: Void Elemental Pickup. Grants 11.25% Class Ability Energy on Pickup.

voidsoul.def: A seeking soul summoned from your rift that drains, weakens and suppresses a target.
voidsoul.q: Cast your rift to create a Void Soul.

slow.def: A stacking Stasis debuff that reduces enemy movement and accuracy; 100 stacks freezes the target.
slow.q: Freeze occurs upon reaching x100 Slow.

freeze.def: A Stasis debuff that fully immobilizes enemies until they are shattered or it wears off.
freeze.q: Frozen Enemies are completely immobilized, rendering them unable to shoot, use abilities, or move.

shatter.def: Breaking a frozen enemy or Stasis crystal, which deals area Stasis damage.
shatter.q: Frozen Enemies can be shattered through damage or directly through specific Stasis Aspects

stasiscrystal.def: A Stasis pillar created on surfaces that freezes nearby enemies when formed and deals damage when shattered.
stasiscrystal.q: Crystals, upon being created, inflict freeze [x15 Slow Stacks for 1.5+0.5 seconds] to enemies within 2.6 metres.

stasisshard.def: A Stasis elemental pickup created by shattering or killing slowed/frozen enemies; it grants melee energy.
stasisshard.q: Stasis Elemental Pickup: Stasis Shards grant Melee Ability Energy on pickup.

frostarmor.def: A stacking Stasis buff that grants damage resistance per stack and decays over time.
frostarmor.q: Grants 7% [2%] Damage Resist per stack, up to 31.25% [10%] Damage Resist at x5 stacks

sever.def: A Strand debuff that reduces the damage an enemy deals.
sever.q: Decreases the enemy's outgoing damage dealt by 40% [15%] for 10+5 [5+2.5] seconds.

suspend.def: A Strand debuff that lifts enemies into the air, leaving them unable to move, shoot or use abilities.
suspend.q: Suspended Combatants are unable to move, shoot, or use abilities.

unravel.def: A Strand debuff that makes damaged enemies fire seeking threads that spread Unravel to others.
unravel.q: Unraveled Enemies release 3 seeking threads towards enemies

wovenmail.def: A Strand buff that grants high damage resistance for a short time.

threadling.def: A small Strand minion that chases enemies and explodes on contact.
threadling.q: Strand minions that chase enemies within 20? metres, leaping towards the targeted enemy upon being within ? metres.

tangle.def: A Strand elemental pickup left by killing Strand-debuffed enemies; it can be thrown or shot to explode, or grappled for grenade energy.
tangle.q: Killing an enemy affected by a Strand Debuff (Sever, Suspend, Unravel) spawns a Tangle

transcendence.def: A Prismatic state charged by dealing Light and Darkness damage; it refills grenade and melee, swaps in a Prismatic grenade and grants buffs.
transcendence.q: Instantly recharges 2 Grenade and Melee Ability Charges on activation.

orbofpower.def: A pickup created by kills and mods that grants Super energy (and Armor Charge with Armor Charge mods).
orbofpower.q: creates an Orb of Power that grants 2.5% Super Energy

armorcharge.def: A stacking resource (3 stacks by default) used by Armor Charge mods, mainly gained by picking up Orbs of Power.
armorcharge.q: Armor Charges are a resource used by Armor Charge Mods

healing.def: Restoring your or allies' health, from any source.
healing.q: Melee Kills begin health regeneration for the user and allies

grenadeenergy.def: Energy that recharges your grenade ability.
grenadeenergy.q: Melee Kills grant Grenade Energy based on Enemy Rank.

meleeenergy.def: Energy that recharges your melee ability.
meleeenergy.q: Grenade Ability Damage grants Melee Energy.

classenergy.def: Energy that recharges your class ability.
classenergy.q: Grants 11.25% Class Ability Energy on Pickup.

superenergy.def: Energy that charges your Super ability, earned through damage, kills and Orbs of Power.
superenergy.q: Dealing and receiving damage, as well as Kills and Assist all directly contribute to charging your Super Ability.

grenade.q: Ability Chunk Energy Gains are generally defined by the base cooldowns of all Abilities, including Class, Grenade, Melee, and Super Abilities.

melee.q: Ability Chunk Energy Gains are generally defined by the base cooldowns of all Abilities, including Class, Grenade, Melee, and Super Abilities.

classability.def: Your class ability slot (dodge, barricade, rift, Thruster and similar).
classability.q: Ability Chunk Energy Gains are generally defined by the base cooldowns of all Abilities, including Class, Grenade, Melee, and Super Abilities.

super.q: Dealing and receiving damage, as well as Kills and Assist all directly contribute to charging your Super Ability.

movement.def: Your jump, glide or lift ability.
movement.q: While airborne, jump a second time to reach greater heights.

finisher.def: A close-range execution on a low-health enemy; many fragments and mods trigger on it.

rift.def: The Warlock class ability that conjures a zone on the ground that heals or empowers those inside.
rift.q: Conjures an Empowering Rift beneath the caster for 15 seconds.

barricade.def: The Titan class ability that raises a protective wall in front of you.
barricade.q: Creates a short, curved barricade construct in front of the caster that blocks all damage dealt to it.

dodge.def: The Hunter class ability: a quick evasive roll or leap.
dodge.q: Removes Combatant Projectile Tracking, as well as Aim Assist against Guardians during the Dodge Animation.

solinvictus.def: A Solar buff from standing in a Sunspot that speeds up grenade and melee regeneration and slows Super drain.
solinvictus.q: Sol Invictus grants 100% Increased Base Grenade and Melee Regeneration Rate, and 40% Decreased Passive Super Drain.

speedbooster.def: An Arc buff gained by sprinting while Amplified that maximizes movement speed and adds damage resistance.
speedbooster.q: While Amplified, sprinting for 2.5 seconds grants Speed Booster.

arcsoul.def: A floating Arc turret summoned from your rift that fires at nearby enemies.
arcsoul.q: Cast your Rift to create an Arc Soul that fires at targets in front of you.

volatilerounds.def: A Void buff that makes your Void weapons apply Volatile on hit.
volatilerounds.q: Void Weapons inflict Volatile upon dealing damage

unravelingrounds.def: A Strand buff that makes your Strand weapons apply Unravel on hit.
unravelingrounds.q: Strand Weapons inflict Unravel upon dealing damage.

grappletangle.def: A Strand anchor that can only be grappled; it cannot be picked up or destroyed.
grappletangle.q: Tangle Equivalent that exclusively interacts with Grapple, behaving identically to a Tangle for Grappling.

elementalpickup.def: Any subclass pickup: Firesprites, Ionic Traces, Void Breaches, Stasis Shards or Tangles.
elementalpickup.q: Elemental Pickups include Firesprites, Ionic Traces, Stasis Shards, Tangles, and Void Breaches.

stun.def: Interrupting a Champion so it briefly cannot attack, move or use abilities; certain verbs stun specific Champion types.
stun.q: Stunning prevents the Champion from attacking, moving, or using any abilities.

airborne.def: Being off the ground (jumping, gliding or lifting); some pieces require or reward it.
airborne.q: While airborne, jump a second time to reach greater heights.

criticalhealth.def: Being at very low health; several fragments and exotics trigger on it.
criticalhealth.q: Upon reaching Critical Health: 400% [200%] Additional Base Grenade and Melee Ability Regeneration Rate.
